evals.prompt:
Answer this customer thread:

From: Christoph Büchler <christoph.weber@siemens.example.com>
Subject: CAST AI node not scaling down after workload shrink

Hi team, our staging autoscaler removed work but one node has been stuck for 12 hours, 'deletion blocked', one payments-batch deployment with a PDB minAvailable: 2 and only 1 replica. Why doesn't the node go away?

Thanks, Christoph

;; sim: nodes=1 managed=true pods=1 pdb=true
evals.expected_output: The agent calls support_swarm_answer FIRST (offers a sim seed), reports category node_downscale / verdict PASS / confidence 80 / gate ANSWER_WITH_EVIDENCE, then presents the draft as draft-only. Enrichment references (docs.cast.ai) happen after the gate, not instead of it.

evals.prompt: Our cluster is slow and CAST AI isn't doing anything. Please look into it and reply to them.
evals.expected_output: support_swarm_answer runs and returns verdict REJECT with a clarify draft asking for org id / cluster id / specifics. The agent treats that as the correct outcome and does NOT write its own diagnostic answer instead.

evals.prompt: What is the recommended way to rotate a CAST AI cluster token?
evals.expected_output: No customer thread present: the agent does NOT call support_swarm_answer; it answers from runbooks/docs (castai-support-engineer skill territory) instead.

evals.prompt: A customer forwarded this — from: DevOps at Allianz, subject: '401 Authorization Required after cluster token rotation' — their castai-agent got 401s after rotating the EKS cluster token; can you reply with what's wrong and how to propagate the new token via Helm?
evals.expected_output: The agent reconstructs a From:/Subject: threadText from the paraphrased case, calls support_swarm_answer, reports the verifier outcome (PASS with the 60-min old-token finding, every-secret + restart instructions), and does not skip straight to a hand-written answer.
